description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kurikotuwa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510251 (23/0358)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and owner details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
